notes.title: Emperium 1.5.8 Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]A New Year![/h1]

Hello everyone and welcome to the first Emperium update of 2025, you know it's really weird to think that I've been working on this game for as long as I have been. The earliest builds of the game were committed to Steam in August of 2019, and now 6 years down the line it's still something I think about a lot. Even when I take breaks from working on Emperium they're always just breaks, I've never ever thought for a moment that I would be done with this project.

To bring in the new year I'm releasing an update that was supposed to go out last year but I got caught up in real life and was ultimately distracted in the final stages of development. I've gone back and (hopefully) wrapped a pretty bow on everything and it is now ready to release.

In this post I'll outline everything coming in Emperium 1.5.8!

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]

The headlining feature of this update are Steam Achievements! Steamworks is now integrated into the game and doing certain things in the game will grant achievements. There aren't many right now, mostly just for clearing the raids on their default difficulty, as well as collection milestone achievements for Proofs of Victory.

[h2]Story Modes[/h2]

The other main feature of this patch includes story mode difficulty option for all the raids [i]except[/i] the ones added in 1.5 and 1.5.5, this is because they are still technically "current" content. Once 2.0 (hopefully) releases all content in the base game will be able to be cleared on Story Mode.

[h2]Bug Fixes, and Quality of Life[/h2]

This patch also brings with it LOADS of bug fixes and other quality of life features, including a new UI for hiring party members. The game is overall a lot more playable than it was in the past, due to some extra testing this time around. I wanted this update to serve as a "definitive" edition to the game, in case I never finish 2.0. 


All this will be coming to the live game on Tuesday, January 21st around 10-11 am so keep an eye out!

notes.title: Emperium 1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
===============Emperium Patch 1.5=================================
Content in this patch includes;
	-Nexus Dungeon Sunsetting Phase 3
	-Abyss's Horizon Raid
	-The Breach Dungeon
	-New Gear Enhancement Material
	-Elemental Weapon Updates
	-Elemental Labyrinth Updates
	-Gathering Updates
	-Crafting Updates
	-Proofs of Victory Updates
	-New Story Chapters
	-Job Balance
	-Misc Additions and Updates
	-Bug Fixes
===============Nexus Dungeon Sunsetting===========================
	With the implementation of patch 1.5 the Nexus Dungeon system
has been completely removed from the game. Thank you to everyone who enjoyed
it, my hope is to create content in the future that will make up for the lack
of replayable content.
===============Abyss's Horizon Raid===============================
	A brand new raid that drops item level 160 weapons and armor.
The raid will be six bosses and feature less linearity than previous raids.
Bosses 2-5 can be challenged in any order, however Boss 5 will be greatly enhanced
by three buffs. With every additional boss defeated Boss 5 will lose a buff.
You can choose to defeat specific bosses to remove more troublesome buffs and
take on Boss 5 early in order to reach the sixth boss sooner, or you can fight
it at it's full power for more of a challenge. There will be bonus rewards if you
do defeat Boss 5 with it's three buffs.
	The final boss of the raid is the last major end boss of the base game
and as a result it will be made incredibly special. Part of why this raid is small
when compared to something like Citadel is I want more time to work on the final boss.

	The item level 160 gear dropped from the raid will have a set bonus
increasing maximum HP and primary stats. The four set bonus will also apply a new
status called "Umbral Empowerment" which will further increase your stats as well as
interact with a few different things inside the raid and dungeon.
	This raid will not drop accessories as there will be one more single boss
raid released in patch 1.5.5 that will serve as a kind of epilogue to the base game.
That will be where the item level 160 accessories will be obtained.
===============The Breach Dungeon=================================
	A brand new dungeon that drops item level 145 weapons and armor.
This dungeon is three bosses and will be more traditional compared to the last
couple of dungeons, I hope you enjoy!
===============New Gear Enhancement===============================
	A new item is made available in patch 1.5 known as an Umbra Shard.
 Umbra Shards are a new type of augment for gear. Item level 160 chest pieces
will have an Umbra Shard slot instead of a gem. Umbra shards increase all primary
stats by a percentage. They are incredibly powerful however they require a large
amount of a material called "Umbral Fragment" with each shard costing 100 fragments.

	The shard combined with the tier set bonus will equal a 20% increase in your
primary stat when wearing best in slot gear. Your character will be the strongest they've
ever been by the end of the 1.5 cycle and will make leveling to 50 in 2.0 much easier.
	Shards are obtained through killing bosses and harvesting nodes within
the dungeon and raid zones.
===============Elemental Weapon Updates===========================
	The final stage of the Elemental Weapons will be made available
in patch 1.5. They will be item level 190 and grant a new skill when equipped.
The skills will be the same ones gained from equipping the Greatscale Weapons
obtained from Zahak's Domain raid that was added in patch 1.3. A lot of these
skills will be added to the job kits permanently in version 2.0 please look
forward to it!
===============Proofs of Victory Updates==========================
	Proofs of Victory (PoV)were a forgotten feature as there hasn't been any new
ones since patch 1.3, however in version 1.5 there will be 8 brand new
proofs of victory obtainable from various pieces of content. And to support
all the new PoV's additional rewards will be added to the system. Not only
that but the number of Proofs you have obtained will now be shown in the save
screen.
===============Job Balance========================================
**Base Stat Changes**
Jobs have had their Base HP adjusted across the board;
	Paladin;
		level * 200 ----> level * 150
	Warrior;
		level * 185 ----> level * 160
	White Mage;
		level * 85 ----> level * 100
	Fortune Teller;
		level * 100 ----> level * 105
	Black Mage;
		level * 50 ----> level * 95
	Arcanist;
		level * 75 ----> level * 100
	Monk;
		level * 125 ----> level * 115
	Ninja;
		level * 120 ----> level * 115
	Gunner;
		level * 70 ----> level * 100
	Bard;
		level * 100 ----> level * 110
**Basic Commands**
Guard has been changed;
	HP recovered reduced 10% ----> 5%
	MP recovered increased 10% ---> 15%
**Black Mage**
Channel Mana has been changed;
	MP regenerated 75% ----> 100%
Supernova has been changed;
	a.mat * 15 - b.mdf * 3 ----> a.mat * 10 - b.mdf * 5
**Monk**
Snap Punch has been changed;
	Damage dealt increased: a.atk * 4 - b.def * 3 ----> a.atk * 5 - b.def * 2
**White Mage**
Cure has been changed;
	Healing Potency Reduced: a.mat * 8 ----> a.mat * 4
Medica has been changed;
	Healing Potency Reduced: a.mat * 9 ----> a.mat * 6
**Fortune Teller**
Fortune has been changed;
	Healing Potency Reduced: a.mat * 5 ----> a.mat * 3
Fortune II has been changed;
	Healing Potency Reduced: a.mat * 8 ----> a.mat * 5
Helios has been changed;
	Healing Potency Reduced: a.mat * 8 ----> a.mat * 6
==============Adjustments & Misc Additions========================
-New gathering materials have been added on Tier 3 and 4 nodes.
-New Tier of food has been introduced.
-Material requirements for crafting food items have been reduced
-Weekend bonus rewards have been increased.
-Teleport menu has been updated so that undiscovered locations will not be visible
on the list.
-Mail story chapters 1 through 5 have been changed so that they will not be visible until the proper
condition has been met, whether through a level requirement or boss kill.
-Main Story chapters 6 through 30 have been changed so that they will not be visible until their
relavent Eternal Quest has been started.
-Eternal Quest Chapters will now remain hidden until the previous Eternal Quest Chapter has been
completed.
	*This is not the case for The Sundered Plains and the Elemental Labyrinth
-HP and MP will now regenerate out of combat in dungeons and raids.
-New Music has been added to dungeon and raid zones.
-Final boss encounters in dungeons and raids now have a unique theme
-A new tileset has been added to the Elemental Labyrinth, new skills have also been
added to the mimics for this new tileset.
-HP values of mobs in the overworld have been adjusted.
-When accepting the Quest "Take me to Church" the camera will now pan over to the NPC
you need to speak to.
-Reputation needed to unlock Crestmorne Temple Normal has been lowered.
======================Bug Fixes===================================
-Several sets of weapons were missing basic item descriptions and 
stats that has been fixed
-Nightsworn Shield had the incorrect rarity
-Forgotten Shield had no meta data attached to it.
-Fixed a bug where you could not obtain weekend bonus rewards from the Arcane Archive
-Fixed incorrect dialogue when prompted to leave the dungeon after completing the Arcane Archives
-Fixed a bug where the wrong story chapter was set to complete after finishing Story Chapter 20
-Fixed a bug where it displayed the wrong key count requirement to progress past a boss floor in the Elemental Labyrinth
-Fixed a bug where sometimes the tileset would change in the middle of a run in the Elemental Labyrinth
-Fixed a bug when progressing past a boss floor in the elemental labyrinth the wrong amount of keys would be subtracted from the player
-Fixed a bug where under certain conditions Emperial Arrow would not reset Damage over time effects applied by Bards

notes.title: Emperium Dev Log #16
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

Hello everyone! This is the blog post of 2023 and it's sort of crazy that the game has been public for almost two years now. It's been a long long road but this year will conclude the first major cycle of updates for Emperium. This does not mean the game is finished, far from it, and there's plenty of content coming still. Today's post will detail what is coming in Emperium Version 1.5.

But before I can talk about the actual content I want to announce the name of the patch...introducing Emperium 1.5.0 "[b]Nocturnum's Heart[/b]" the term Nocturnum was first introduced in 1.4 and will be brought back and expanded more in this patch as it has significance going back to the Magnus Ren.

[h2]Raids and Dungeon[/h2]

The raid for 1.5 will be six bosses long, it's not going to be as long as Citadel simply because I wish to spend more time on the final boss given how important it is. The raid itself will drop item level 160 gear and will have a set bonus available to all armor types. The raid will only drop armor and weapons, item level 160 accessories will drop from a one boss raid made available in patch 1.5.5. It is still far too early to talk about 1.5.5 but it will be a minor patch coming a month or so after 1.5 releases.

There is also a new system coming this patch that involves a brand new type of attachable augment which will drastically increase main stats (STR, INT, DEX). A big theme of this patch is increasing power of ridiculous degrees because of it being the last patch in the cycle.

The dungeon will be more standard than the last few patches. It will have three bosses and drop item level 145 weapons and armor. As established in 1.3 the armor and weapons are 15 item levels lower than the dungeon gear and will have limited infusion slots.

[h2]Misc Content[/h2]

A big part of this patch will be updating older systems with new content. First of which includes new Proofs of Victory (PoV's) for the first time since 1.2, these new ones are from content going back to patch 1.3 so be sure to start farming out old raids for materials and chances of getting Proofs! Like before the statues added to the Hall of Champions have some unique lore on them.

The second is something that was originally planned for version 1.4 that slipped through but will be added in 1.5 which are new hunt targets for the remaining zones that don't have any, Deathstroke Marsh, and the Sundered Plains.

Finally the last stage of the weapon upgrades will be made available. They will be item level 190 and while equipped will grant the ability to use the a unique skill. This is the same skill that was available from the Greatscale weapons, I identify that some of these are fun and unique and going into 2.0 some will definitely be added permanently to job kits, but for now they are still attached to the weapons.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Before I end the post I want to give an update on progress made so far, to give a realistic idea of how far out it is.

2/4 Story Chapters are done. (There are only 4 chapters in 1.5 and the final one will be in 1.5.5)
3/3 Dungeon bosses are done.
1/6 Raid bosses are done.

The gear for the dungeon and raid currently does not have stats, but the new augment is working and the data base work is done.

As you can see the patch is still early and while I hope to get it done sooner rather than later I'm not going to force myself as that will just more quickly lead to burn out. I hope to at least keep getting blogs out as long as I make progress. See you all next month!

notes.title: Emperium 1.4 Patch Notes Preview
notes.content:
[h2][b]Emperium 1.4 is releasing on November 29th! Here are the Patch Notes, job changes will be released on Monday![/b][/h2]

[b][h1]Emperium 1.4 "King's Fall" Update[/h1][/b]
Content in this update includes....
[list]
[*]Nexus Dungeon Sun setting Phase 2
[*]Nocturnum Temple Raid
[*]Arcane Archives Dungeon
[*]Elemental Weapon updates
[*]Accessories 2.0
[*]Hunting System Updates
[*]New Story Chapters
[*]Job Balance 
[*]Misc Additions and Updates
[*]Bug Fixes
[/list]


[b][h2]Nexus Dungeons[/h2][/b]
	As stated in the version 1.3 patch notes further aspects of the
Nexus Dungeon system are being removed. The Nexus has been completely closed
if you character is still inside the nexus when version 1.4 releases you will
be prompted to teleport out. You are now unable to purchase the Nexus related
accessories from the exchange vendor in Agran City. Any extra Magnus Ren coins
can be sold for Unaspected Aetherial Dust. 

[b][h2]Nocturnum Temple Raid[/h2][/b]
	A new two boss high difficulty raid will be made available upon completion of 
MSQ Chapter 23. This raid will drop item level 130 accessories

[b][h2]Arcane Arcives[/h2][/b]
	A new three boss dungeon that will be made available upon completion
of MSQ Chapter 22. This dungeon will drop item level 120 weapons.

[b][h2]Elemental Weapon Update[/h2][/b]
	As of patch 1.4 tier 7 elemental weapons are available.
These are made by scrapping the tier 6 to convert it into 60 essence, as well
as 20 Beastial Bones a new item dropped from Hunt Monsters as of this update.

	Tier 7 weapons are item level 120 and represent the penultimate stage
of weapon. The final stage will be made available upon the release of patch 1.5

[b][h2]Accessories 2.0[/h2][/b]
	Accessories throughout the game so far have been "evergreen"
with them never really falling out of style and them remaining just as strong
as they were when first introduced. This presented a problem as it restricted
what could be done with class design as well as encounters. Having to think
about what random ring from 2 raids ago could break the current one.

Unique accessories like the "Ring of the Umbral Heart" will have their current effect
disabled and a new one will be added, with some exceptions. Accessories with resistence 
effects will not be changed.

This does not apply retroactively so I'm asking you to please don't abuse the old accessories
and use the new ones instead m(_ _)m

[b][h2]Accessories Updates[/h2][/b]
	Overview; As a baseline all accessories now have stats associated
with their item level. All necklaces will give HP based on their item level.
All rings will give MP based on their item level. All accessories will be generic

Stag Set; Unchanged
Dreamer's Set; Unchanged
Greater Knowledge Set; Unchanged
Greater Fire Resistance Set; Unchanged
Molten Set; Unchanged
Heavy Frost Set; Unchanged
Kilrogg's Warband; Updated
	Kilrogg's Eye; Increase Critical Strike Chance by 2%
	Equippable by; All
Shattered Sun Accessories; Updated
	Shattered Sun Locket; +1% MP regen
	Shattered Sun Mage Relic; +1 Mana Cost Reduction
	Shattered Sun Emblem; +1% Critical Strike Damage
	Shattered Sun Warrior Relic; +1% Critical Strike Chance
	Shattered Sun Necklace; +1% HP regen
	Shattered Sun Pyromancer Charm; +3% Fire Resistance
Pendant of Relentless Elements; Updated
	All element resistance +5% ----> +2%
	Set Bonus nerf 500 barrier ---> 250 barrier
Ring of Southern Winds; Reworked
		Invictus Ring; Critical Strike Damage 1%
Necklace of Frenzied Spirit; Updated
	+5% Critical Strike Chance ---> +3% Critical Strike Chance

[b][h2]Hunt System Updates[/h2][/b]
	The three original world bosses have been updated to fit
more in line with the Hunt system introduced on the Isle of Umbra.
This means they now have spawn conditions that must be met rather than
one spawning at random once per in game week.

	All Hunt targets can now drop Beastial Bones which is a
material integral to upgrading the elemental weapons to tier 7.
(More information about Tier 7 Elemental Weapons can be found in their respective section)

[b][h2]Job Updates[/h2][/b]
	The updates have been omitted, the full changes will be available on Tuesday when the patch
releases.


[b][h2]Adjustments & Misc Additions[/h2][/b]

[*]Adjusted the recommended minimum item level for Citadel of Night.
[*]Corrected bosses not resetting properly in the Citadel of Night.
[/list]


[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Paladin Action "Shield Toss" was not properly classified as a physical skill
[*]Fixed a bug that unintentionally teleported the player into Chapter 18 scenario instead of a location
in the overworld.

[*]Fixed an issue in certain MSQ chapters where you would be able to travel out of bounds.

notes.title: Emperium Devlog #15; 1.4 Release date, state of the game
notes.content:
[h1]Emperium 1.4 release date[/h1]

After 6 long months full of burn out I have finally finished Emperium's fourth major update "King's Fall" will be releasing on November 29th, with the preview notes being posted tomorrow November 25th. Since it has been so long since the last Devlog detailing the 1.4 update, this log will mostly be a refresher on the content coming next Tuesday. There will also be a brief update on Emperium 1.5 the final update for Emperium 1.X cycle of patches.

[h2]The Content[/h2]

Coming with the release of Emperium 1.4 you will be able to go through 5 more chapters of the main story, since this is the penultimate patch the story involving the Nightsworn will be mostly wrapped up, but there is a single loose end that will bring everything to a conclusion in 1.5. 

Unlocked through the main story you will go through the Arcane Archives, located below the Citadel of Night it is home to an ancient treasure that might be the answer the Hero of Emperium needs to defeat Archiel.

Also unlocked through the main story is a two boss raid known as the "Nocturnum Temple" (Previously this was called the Magnus Ren ruins). While there are only two bosses they will be incredibly challenging and it is recommended you have the best gear you can get before challenging this raid. Completion of this raid is required to finish the patch story content, however a story mode of the raid will become available in 1.5.

The original world bosses have been updated to fall in line with the new hunting system introduced in 1.3. They all have unique spawn conditions and hints at those spawn conditions are available from a new npc in Agran city. Hunt targets have also had a new material added to their loot tables.

Finally Tier 7 Elemental weapons are now available. They are still weaker than the current best in slot but be assured that the final tier of elemental weapon will be worth all the effort you have put into it.

while normally I would have more of the next patch done by the time the previous patch is about to release, 1.5 has only just entered preproduction. I don't expect it to take another 6+ months it will be some time, especially because I really want to get the final raid as good as it can be. Looking into the far future there will probably be news of Emperium 2.0 some time slightly before 1.5 releases.

Thank you all for reading this post it was a lot of text but I needed to update everyone, after such a long period of radio silence.

Hello! Welcome to the first devlog on Emperium 1.4. This is the second to last major update for Emperium, and while these last two updates will have major features they will overall be smaller than something like 1.3. Now lets begin talking about the content!!! Firstly the name of this patch is....[b]King's Fall[/b]

As made clear in the patch title, this update focuses on the Nightsworn King, and your final confrontation against him, however before you can fight him you must learn who he really is. 

Major Content in 1.4 includes...
[list]
[*]New 2 Boss Raid: Magnus Ren Ruins
[*]New Dungeon: Arcane Vaults
[*]Additional Steps to the Elemental Weapon
[*]Expanded Hunting System
[*]5 New Story Chapters
[*]Accessories Update
[/list]

What I'm most excited about is the raid, I've been planning it for a similar amount of time as the Citadel of Night. I don't think it's too much of a spoiler to say you will be fighting Archiel this patch, and I'm trying make the Archiel encounter really special.

here is a preview of the raid:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/949929f1079465b234ca2634de5062ff2d3d5d9a.png[/img]

The final bit of information is that there is going to be a pretty major update to accessories in the game. Accessories are defined as anything that goes in the ring and necklace armor slots. Basically at the moment rings and necklaces are evergreen which is not something I would like. I want armor over time to become "junk" so that there is always a reason to run the most current content. To fix this accessories are going to focus mostly on "special" parameters like hp mp, and bp regen. Crit chance, crit damage

In conclusion, the patch is already coming along pretty smoothly. I have an internal release date I'm aiming for, and I think that newer techniques I discovered in the creation of the Citadel of Night will allow raid testing to go much faster. See you next month! notes.title: Emperium 1.3 "Into the Dark" Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Emperium 1.3 is releasing on April 26th! Here are the Patch Notes, job changes will be released on Monday![/b][/h2]

[b][h1]Emperium 1.3 "Into the Dark" Update[/h1][/b]
Content in this update includes....
[list]
[*]Nexus Dungeon Sun setting Phase 1
[*]Isle of Umbra Zone
[*]Citadel of Night Raid
[*]Ruined Sewers Dungeon
[*]Hunting System
[*]Gathering Updates
[*]Item Crafting Update
[*]Emperium 1 Year Anniversary Event
[*]New Story Chapters
[*]Job Balance
[*]Misc Additions and Updates
[*]Bug Fixes
[/list]

[b][h2]Nexus Dungeons[/h2][/b]
Due to the sun setting of the Nexus system game play elements tied
or associated to the Nexus will be removed/changed.
[list]
[*]The Nexus Chapter of the Eternal Quest will be removed.
[*]Hard Mode Dungeons will no longer drop +1 Keys.
[*]Weekly Chest in Agran City will be removed.
[*]Physical Entrance in Daybreak Desert has been removed.
[/list]
The Minted Coins vendor will be removed in 1.4, you will be able to convert Minted
Coins to Vials of Unaspected Aetherial Dust. The system will be completely disabled 
in version 1.5.

[b][h2]Citadel of Night Raid[/h2][/b]
A 9 boss raid instance with a Challenge mode available.
The raid will drop Item Level 130 Armor and Weapons.
It will also drop a new material used to make Aethercubes +2 for further
gear enhancement.

Due to changes in accessories coming in 1.4 this raid will not drop accessories.

[b][h2]Ruined Sewers Dungeon[/h2][/b]
This is a 3 boss dungeon, due to story reasons the dungeon does
not drop gear. Instead of a dungeon set the zone has a vendor that you can purchase gear
using a material that can be gathered from mining nodes in the zone, or obtained via boss
drops in the dungeon. The gear associated with this dungeon is item level 115 with no augment or gem slots.

[b][h2]Hunting System[/h2][/b]
The hunting system is an updated approach to world bosses in Emperium.
Hunt Targets have specific spawning methods that are secret, an NPC will give hints
to what they are but you will have no further help. A Hunt can only be killed once a week
and it drops currencies. This is just the base of the system and will get expanded with more
rewards and targets in 1.4

[b][h2]Gathering System Updates[/h2][/b]
Looking into the future of Emperium gathering is going to
be getting a few major updates, and to start laying that groundwork
a cap needed to be placed on Gathering Skills. Both Mining and Botany
base values will be capped at 200. Botany and Mining gems have been
removed. Originally they were intended to be an easy to way to get
gathering skill, but that was also when it was uncapped. Currently
with the direction I want to take Gathering it needs to be capped
and the gems inflate that skill value too much.

Other changes to gathering include;
[list]
[*]New tier 6 nodes have been added in the new over world zone "Umbra Isle"
[*]Changed how gathering skill bonuses grant additional materials
At each threshold rather than giving +2 and +3 on top of the base amount
they will give just a single additional material for each threshold you reach.
[*]Changed how gathering skill is gained. Previously on all nodes tier 2 and higher
when you reach a skill threshold you gain an additional +1 to gathering skill for each threshold
you reach. This has been changed so you only get a single skill point no matter how many thresholds you reach.
[/list]

[b][h2]Crafting System Update[/h2][/b]
Crafting in Emperium has been a long overlooked part of the game,
as consumables have always been important in MMOs I want them to be significant
in Emperium as well. A full overhaul of the item crafting system has been done in order
for existing consumables to be more accessible. What this will also do is make expansion of
consumables with new tiers of food items and potions easier than before.

The system itself is straight forward, unlock it at the forger in Agran and a new "Synthesis"
option will appear in the main menu.

[b][h2]Emperium 1 Year Anniversary[/h2][/b]
The Emperium 1 Year Anniversary is here! To celebrate speak with the
Town Crier npc in Agran City. Finishing this event will give lots of important
materials so you should really do it!

[b][h2]Job changes[/h2][/b]
Due to Jobs being tweaked up till the last second they specific job changes
have been omitted from these notes.

[b][h2]Misc Adjustments and Changes[/h2][/b]
+2 Aethercube have been added. +2 Aethercubes have been simplified. 
They each only give 1 type of stat (except for fending) In order to craft you 
will need to obtain materials from the Citadel of Night Raid.
[list]
[*]Striking +2
[*]Healing +2
[*]Casting +2
[*]Fending +2
[*]Aiming +2
[/list]
Aethercube +1's have had their recipe changed; 150 Unaspected vials

New Recipes have been added
[list]
[*]Resistance potions of all elements have been added
[*]Stat boosting potions have been added
[*]New Food Items have been added
[/list]
Food Items have been reworked; instead of increasing a main stat food items 
now temporarily boost Max HP in a single combat. Each tier of food item increases 
MaxHP by an increasing amount.

Misc Updates;
[list]
[*]The appearance of a certain location in MSQ chapters has been adjusted.
[*]During certain MSQ cutscenes portraits have been added to the dialogue.
[*]While in combat a new UI element has been added to track the current Turn Number.
[*]Updated the Inn to be more specific about what content will be reset when triggering
a forced weekly reset.
[*]Updated the Inn to now reset the Clock Tower Raid upon forcing a weekly reset.
[*]Significantly increased the amount of health restored via Health Potions.
[*]Skill tomes from the Clockwork Tower Raid have had their drop chances increased.
[*]Several new back end features have been added, one of them will enforce a Damage and Healing cap
[/list]

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where several chapters of the Main Story did not properly reset when you select the
option to replay them.
[*]Fixed a bug where Grand Draw did not work properly
[*]Fixed bug where Fortune Teller still has % based MP costs
[*]Fixed an issue in the tier 4 mining nodes where the the higher skill
bonuses were proccing off of botany skill rather than mining skill.
[*]Fixed an issue where the tool tip for the buff "Freshly Assembled" was incorrect.
[*]Fixed MP potions restoring health instead.
[/list]

notes.title: Emperium Devlog #10 1.3 Dungeon and Hunting system preview
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Welcome back to the Emperium Devlog, This is February's entry and this month we're showcasing the dungeon and hunting system! Now like everything in Emperium 1.3 it's still very early and is subject to change.

[h2]Hunting System[/h2]
Firstly what I wanted to do with the hunting system is iterate on the idea of World Bosses with something more interesting than a simple random spawn per reset. The basis of the Hunting system is that, in any given zone there will be at least 1 boss that can [i]only[/i] spawn when certain conditions are met.

These conditions can be a handful of things, and discovering what those are is up to you as the player to discover. However, there will be hints available at a new NPC known as the Hunt Master. Hunt Masters are only in zones with active hunts, so at the moment old zones will not have a Hunt Master, however I am looking into expanding this system if it goes well. 


When conditions are met a notification will appear letting you know that something has spawned.
There will not be a marker on the map so its up to you to use the hints of the Hunt Master to find the location of the hunt monster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/9c656aaafd876a867f415bb6cdd28e847dd07a2f.png[/img]


[h2]Dungeon[/h2]
The less significant aspect of the patch is the dungeon, and while in the previous I had detailed the raid its because this raid has been in the works since before the game even released. The dungeon however was only finalized after the previous devlog was already published.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/a207c91abcf37f5bcff501d2023b18ba09acef06.png[/img]

The story details of this dungeon aren't going to be talked about. Why you're running through the sewers and where the sewers are is a mystery until you actually get to play the content. This dungeon is unique though, as there is only a single boss! This boss changes each time you fight them but it leads to a dungeon that feels unique and carry more influence on the story than others before. Another unique thing about this dungeon is that the gear is actually higher item level than base raid gear from the Clocktower. This is in an effort to standardize item level gains per patch.

The raid this patch will give item level 130 gear while the dungeon gives 115 gear, and the goal is to increase gear by 30 item levels every time a new raid tier releases. So the 1.5 tier will give item level 160 gear, and the 1.4 dungeon will give item level 125 gear.

This dungeon continues the trend of making dungeons more of an event compared to what they were pre 1.2

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
So that's all there is this month, I have my own internal deadlines that I believe I can meet, but I'm not going to share anything until it becomes clearer. Next month I'll begin talking about what to look forward to during the 1 year anniversary at the end of April, and hopefully have some news about 1.3 release!

notes.title: Devlog #9 Emperium in 2022 and Update 1.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Emperium 1.3[/b][/h1]
Even though Emperium 1.2 just released I'm working hard on 1.3 (though I am taking a couple days off for the new year) The 1.3 update is titled "Into the Dark" and is something I've been outlining and planning for a long time now.

The update is the first one that takes place on a new landmass outside of Emperium where the first 5 zones are. The Isle of Umbra is a massive island and is home to many dangers, the largest being the Nightsworn as the island is their base of operations, and of course what would an Emperium update be without new raid content.

In the Heart of the Isle of Umbra rests the Citadel of Night. A 9 boss raid Instance that will feature a more detailed raid environment when compared to previous raids in Emperium.

The Isle of Umbra zone is not like any other zone in the game, as it not only much larger but also contains its own unique system for spawning world bosses. Unlike the mainland, where world bosses are on a set rotation each week. The world bosses on the Isle of Umbra have their own timers and spawn conditions that are to be discovered in game and are integral to progression in 1.3. The zone itself is massive like I said before, it's so big in fact that it has 3 Aether Tablets



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/72bf71a350ebed26cb46a346a9a2a63924fd033c.png[/img]

 Moving onto the raid, its at the heart, The Citadel of Night is the beginning of the end in regards to the first story arc in Emperium. By the time you finish Chapter 20 you will know what the raid boss is going to be in 1.4. Just a preview of the raid environment;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/af53fdc808e9679080ead9bea26bff6b2e78629d.png[/img]

The whole thing has this castle aesthetic with the first half of the raid has you going through the different sections of the castle, with the end boss being at its pinnacle. Almost all the bosses in this raid have had some appearance in the MSQ which is something new and is really only possible in a raid like this that ties together all the story threads so far.

Overall This patch is shaping up to be nice, I'm excited for the Hunting system as an experiment and plan to expand it further if it turns out well. I can't give a release date or time frame for the patch because it is so early on.

In other news I do plan on an Emperium 1 year anniversary update coming in April. That will be out independently of 1.3 so if 1.3 is not out by then the anniversary will still be there.

notes.title: Emperium Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Emperium 1.2[/b][/h1]

Content in this patch includes;
[list]
[*] Domain of Zahak Super Boss
[*] Battle of Daybreak Dungeon
[*] Elemental Dungeon Updates
[*] Elemental Weapon Updates
[*] New Story Chapters
[*] Job Balance
[*] Adjustments & Misc Changes
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]

As always [b]to begin the new story and get access to the new dungeon
select the new option in the Eternal Quest menu "Nightsworn Invasion"[/b]

[h2][b]Domain of Zahak Raid[/b][/h2]

Overview;
	The Domain of Zahak is a extra difficult 2 boss raid where
you must fight the Lord of Dragons to prevent him from breaking free.

	This new incredibly difficult raid dungeon drops unique item level 115 weapons that
grant players a brand new ability for their class. This ability is designed to be impactful
and most importantly fun to use. You will get 1 weapon for full clearing the raid and the raid is locked
to one clear per week.

	A major goal with the bosses in this raid is a unique emphasis on inter-connectivity in the encounters. Things you do in the first boss will impact the second boss. This boss will also be balanced around the party having a full set of Clocktower Raid gear including the augmented weapon.[b] In order to unlock this raid you must have completed the challenge modes for both Mt Invictus and Clocktower[/b]

[h2][b]Elemental Dungeon[/b][/h2]

Overview; The goal of the elemental dungeon updates this patch is to finish fleshing out the system
this include several updates and additions as well as a renaming of the system to the "Labyrinth of Elements".
To go hand in hand with updating the system a new Eternal Quest Chapter has been added that unlocks the Labyrinth, as well
as a new NPC that you can talk to in order to find the entrance to the Labyrinth on any given day of the week.
[list]
[*] Floors are now divided into sets of 10.
[*] Mobs now gain embolden stacks every 10 floors.
[*] Floors up to 100 now, with a secret final boss on floor 100.
[*] Tile set is now decided upon the start of a run instead of on the weekly reset
[*] Bosses are now static. The boss on the new floor 10 will now always been the floor 10 boss.
[*] Bosses no longer gain Embolden. They will be individually tuned, with the earlier bosses intended to be clearable with a party of 2 and later bosses being tightly tuned full party encounters.
[*] A tutorial will be added to explain the mechanics of the Elemental Dungeon
[*] New Tilesets have been added; Ice and Earth. This also means new skills for mobs
[*] 5 additonal bosses have been added and previous bosses have been revamped.
[*] A new emphasis will be placed on elemental resistances with bosses being the main "resistance check" these checks will become increasingly harsh the further you go.
[/list]

These adjustments will make difficulty scale more evenly. On top of changes to difficulty curve
normal mobs and bosses will have additional skills and mechanics. Finally a new Floor Zero has been added to allow the player
time to set up their builds craft resistance gems, and look at what Attunement the labyrinth is set to.

[h2][b]Elemental Weapon[/b][/h2]

Overview; The elemental weapons are a system that was introduced in 1.0 and there hasn't been any updates to it since Mt Invictus originally launched. With the updates to the Elemental Labyrinth, Tier 4 and 5 of the Elemental weapons have been added. Both steps require you to enter the Labyrinth and farm the new bosses.

Secondly the process of building a weapon has been streamlined. Before each weapon type would give a unique currency when being sold. This unique currency restricted the process forcing you to keep building that single weapon type. This doesn't match up with what I believe is a core design principle of Emperium, which is the freedom to swap and change how you play whenever you want. This basically means there is only 1 currency now called "Legendary Essence" this replaces the Paladin legendary currency. All other legendary currencies have been turned into "Dull Essence" which can be sold to any NPC to convert into Legendary Essence at a ratio of 1:1.

Third, the "Abandon Weapon" option has been replaced with a "Forge New Dull Weapon" allowing you to obtain a new Tier 1 Weapon for 10k gold.

The tier 4 and 5 Elemental Weapons are;
[list]
[*] Refined; Item Level 50
[*] Energized; Item level 75, when equipped gives a new passive effect. At tier 5 Ninjas can pick from either a Dexterity Weapon or a Strength Weapon.
[/list]

[h2][b]Job Balance[/b][/h2]

	[h3][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Magic Points or MP has been standardized across all jobs. Every job will now have a base MP of 10,000. This can be modified through gear, infusions and gems.
[*] Spells and Abilities now cost a fixed amount of MP making MP gains on gear matter compared to when skills were based on a % of maxMP
[*] This change is applied to EVERY ability that had an MP cost. This is an extensive change that impacts every player ability, 
[*] Damage overtime and Healing overtime abilities from the player are now calculated via a formula rather than flat percentages. 
[/list]

	  [h3][b]Trait Change[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Heightened Knowledge has been reverted;
 	-Due to changes in how the MP stat is handled this trait will be reverted to its 1.0 version, increasing maximum MP. 
[*] Second Chance has been Changed;
 	-Additional Actions chance reduced from 5% to 2%

	[b]Paladin[/b]
[*]Shield Toss has been Changed;
No longer costs MP, now has a cooldown of 2 turns.
[*]Swift Blade has been Changed;
Magic Defense Buff reduced from 75% to 10%

	[b]Warrior[/b]

[*]Helm Splitter has been Changed;
No longer costs MP now has a cooldown of 4 turns.

	[b]White Mage[/b]

[*]Aero has been Changed;
Wind Burn now deals a.mat * 2 damage per tick.
[*]Touch of the Goddess has been Changed;
Strength of shield reduced from user.mat * 10 ---> user.mat * 3

	[b]Fortune Teller[/b]

[*]Blessing of Resolve has been Changed;
Potency of defensive buff has been increased from 30% to 45%
Tool tip has been updated to be more clear

	[b]Black Mage[/b]

[*]Blizzard Changed;
Umbral Heart Status no longer increases duration when boosted
Umbral Heart Status duration increased from 2 turns to 3

	[b]Bard[/b]

[*]Heavy Shot has been Changed;
Damage dealt increased; a.dex * 5 - b.def * 3 ---> a.dex * 8 - b.def * 3
Hunter's Mark status changed; duration is now 2 turns.
[*]Heavier Shot has been Changed;
Damage dealt increased; a.dex * 8 - b.def * 2 ---> a.dex * 10 - b.def * 4
[*]Song of War Changed;
Cooldown reduced from 8 turns to 6
[*]Wind's Bite has been changed;
Damage over time effect changed; 2% of maxHP ---> a.dex * 2
[*]Storm Bite has been Changed;
Damage over time effect increased; 2% of maxHP ---> a.dex * 3

	[b]Gunner[/b]

[*]Slug Shot has been Changed;
Damage boosting from BP has been removed.
Tooltip has been updated.
[*]Tactical Nuke has been changed;
Damage dealt increased; a.dex * 5 - b.def * 3 ----> a.dex * 8 - b.def * 3
[*]Target Lock has been changed;
Added tooltip to the buff for improved clarity.

	[b]Ninja[/b]

[*]Backslash has been Changed;
Damage dealt reduced; a.atk * 10 - b.def * 5 ----> a.atk * 8 - b.def * 3
[/list]

[h2][b]Misc Additions and Adjustments[/b][/h2]

	[h3][b]Aether Cube Standardization[/b][/h3]

Aether Cubes are now standardized into giving +10 primary stat and +15 secondary stat at +0. At +1 they will give +15 Primary, +20 Secondary. 
Primary and secondary stats are defined as;
[list]
[*] 	Primary;
 		-Strength
		-Intellect
 		-Dexterity
[*] 	Secondary;
 		-HP
 		-MP
 		-AGI
[/list]

Any Aether Cubes that did not follow this before now adhere to these values.

[list]
[*] Aether Cube of Striking and Aether Cube of Striking +1 have been changed;
Striking Type Aether Cubes now give Strength and Defense in accordance to the value established above.
[*] Gems have had their stat bonus values adjusted;
[*] Primary Stat gems now give +25 instead of +30.
[*] A new Dexterity Gem has been added.
[*] New Light and Darkness resistance Gems have been added.
[*] All resistance gems have had effectiveness reduced from 5% --> 2%
[*] Combat text has been changed. Number popups now have a small animation when they appear. Whenever buffs and debuffs are applied to enemies or allies floating text will appear showing the name of the buff. Having a visual representations will hopefully make combat more clear whenever things happen.
[*] The General Melee category of gear has been renamed to "General Physical"
[*] Additional Dialogue has been added to the final encounter of Clocktower Raid
[*] NPCs have been moved around in A'ri Wilds settlement to accommodate for a new location.
[*] A'ri Wilds map has been edited there is now a path
[*] Fixed a problem where teleporting out of a dungeon via the "F" menu did not properly update
[*] that you were out of a dungeon.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Emperium Devlog #7
notes.content:
[h1]Intro[/h1]
So to begin, Hi! It's been a long time since I've posted anything and its due to a couple of things. My priority is irl and other commitments as this game is a hobby at the end of the day so progress on it will be slow at times fast during others. Going forward I'm going to try and have at an update once a month to show off even the small things I get done.

Before going into the content I have to show off today, I'm just going to give a quick tldr on everything.
[list]
[*]The patch is currently 95-98% done just needs testing
[*]Just needs some testing, aiming to release mid to late December
[*]First blog posts about 1.3 will be posted end of December around the time 1.2 is releasing
[/list]

[h1]Patch Contents[/h1]
The full contents of the patch include
[list]
[*]Domain of Zahak Superboss
[*]Battle of Daybreak Dungeon
[*]Elemental Dungeon Updates
[*]5 New story Chapters
[*]Job Changes, Misc Changes, and bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Dungeon Preview[/h3]
The main thing I want to show off today is the dungeon. The goal I had with this dungeon is to make it an event, I wanted it to be cinematic and convey the story better than any other dungeon so far. The challenge with this is that I wanted subsequent clears of the dungeon to not have to worry about cutscenes. To do this a new interactable object has been placed in this dungeon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/33cf62b7699726d2739416d61cb6d8b9122ffaed.png[/img]
The cutscene reset orb allows you to view the story again after viewing it once, if you do not interact with this object you will only have to view the cutscene 1 time.

This dungeon has the standard 3 bosses and they all have pretty unique mechanics that open the door for cool things in the future. There's actually a lot of new mechanics in this patch that I'm adding to my tool kit for the next full size raid in 1.3. The dungeon also features a trash pack which is a new thing for Emperium Dungeons, I wanted to make sure the trash felt interesting so even the trash has new mechanics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/67b8f6d2a658c19c0238c42f2d048a21fb5f31a8.png[/img]
[i]A screenshot from the first zone of the dungeon known as the "Dry Wastes"[/i]

[h3]Main Story[/h3]
The other focus of this patch is the story, my goal with the main story is to continue to evolve it and raise the bar in terms of quality. The story this patch in particular has a lot of different instances and scenarios that escalate the story and by the end of 1.2 you will know where we're going for 1.3!

[h3]Zahak's Domain[/h3]
Finally the headlining feature of the patch is the Superboss. I can't show anything because I don't want to spoil the encounter at all, but the final boss is a long endurance test of a fight with multiple phases. It is probably slightly more complex then the Ifrit encounter from Mt Invictus.

notes.title: Emperium Devlog #6; 1.2 and beyond
notes.content:
[h1][b]Introduction[/b][/h1]
Hello! It's been a while since a proper devlog but since 1.1 I've been incredibly busy in real life which cause me to neglect posting updates, but I have kept working plucking away at the 1.2 update, and while it is still awhile before release I have some things I can share to give an idea of how 1.2 is going to go.

[h3][b]Emperium 1.2[/b][/h3]
Emperium 1.2 is the game's first example of a small patch. The Emperium patch cycle heavily mirrors Final Fantasy XIV where after a raid tier release there is a smaller sized patch that adds new side content or improves existing systems. That is what 1.2 is, while there is new raiding content it is on a smaller scale than a normal raid. Of course there are also 5 new story chapters pushing us towards the next Chapter of the Eternal Quest.

Today I do have a few bits of information about the new raiding content. It's at an experimental difficulty which is harder than any boss that's been in Emperium before. I've been calling it a "Superboss" internally as a callback to classic final fantasy games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/10bafe511b6d40a4e53098dabad220c8b4712d3b.png[/img]

Superboss is actually 2 bosses, where how you resolve mechanics in the first boss changes how you handle the second boss. There is a "right" answer but part of the challenge will be the puzzle. These bosses are tuned to be harder than anything in Clocktower, with the final encounter of this mini raid is now the holder of the title "has the most health" I'm working really hard to make this boss something special.

There is one other significant bit of content in 1.2 and that's the completion of the Elemental Dungeon System. The Elemental Dungeons as they are now is still in a kind of proof of concept phase, currently they stop at floor 70, I plan for it to go down to floor 100, with more intricate bosses and an eventually a climactic final boss on floor 101. With the Elemental dungeons there will also be new tilesets, modifiers for each set of floors, and of course a new step in your Legendary Weapon. The Legendary got neglected in 1.1 but in 1.2 it will become even more powerful rivaling some raid weapons.

[h3][b]Beyond 1.2[/b][/h3]

While I can't really promise anything yet, Emperium will be getting a rather huge update after 1.2, it's going to be the largest single patch in the games short history and I'm really excited to share it more information with you all when its closer. Currently I had to downscale the size of the 1.2 patch and I'm using the extra dev time its given me to get a head start on 1.3.

As 1.2 gets closer to finishing I'll post another blog with patch title, release date all that good information! I want to take the time to say thank you for playing or even trying Emperium, I'm a single person making a really huge game with lots of moving parts, but its fun! And I hope you all enjoy what's coming down the pipe.

notes.content:

[list]

[i]Preface[/i]
Trying something new with this patch's notes, basically all the actual new content updates and additions will be in these preliminary, and the detailed job changes and bug fixes will be in the full notes. I'm splitting them into 2 parts just to keep things slightly organized, everything together can be found in game via the patch notes option.

[h2][b]Clockwork Tower[/b][/h2]
The Clockwork Tower is a 6 boss raid instance that drops item level 80 weapons and item level 90 armor. It is unlocked through the Main Story Quest Progression. The raid also comes with a new system that will let you "augment" your item level 80 weapons turning them into item level 100 weapons. Augmenting requires multiple full clears of the raid, due to there not being a skip this time around. 
To augment 1 weapon you will need to "scrap" (Disasemble) 5 unaugmented weapons. Each weapon gives 10 parts when scrapped. You will also need 5 Ancient Gears (this is the raid currency this time, think like invictus embers) Each boss can drop Ancient Gears but the chance starts low and becomes guaranteed by the time you reach the last boss. You also get more Gears by completing the Hard Mode of the Raid.

[h2][b]Magnus Ren Factory Dungeon[/b][/h2]
The first new dungeon added to Emperium, this 3 boss instance is unlocked via story progression. It drops Item level 45 weapons. Please note that the Nexus will be unavailable until you first clear of the Magnus Ren Factory. Upon first time completion of the dungeon, the Nexus will become available again as well as be added to the pool of Nexus Dungeons.

[h2][b]Nexus Updates[/b][/h2]
There are several updates and new additions to the Nexus;
[list]
[*]The old affix "Burning" has been retired and new "Explosive" has been added
[*]A new weekly chest is available, granting scaling rewards based on the highest level dungeon completed that in game week
[*]A new currency only obtained through completing a +6 or higher. It can be used to purchase exclusive Season 2 Accessories that grant bonuses while inside the Nexus.
[*]New levels of dungeons are available. You can complete up to a +20 now.
[*]New Proofs of Victory are now available, they are obtained by completing a +15 and a +20
[*]Season 1 Rewards will be distributed upon entering the Nexus for the first time after the patch.
[/list]

notes.title: Emperium Devlog #5 Raid 2, The Clockwork Tower, and 1.1 Release Date
notes.content:
[h1][b]Introduction[/b][/h1]

The Clockwork Tower is a location that's been in the game since launch and in 1.1 you'll be able to enter and climb it, fighting the machines within. In this Devblog we'll be previewing a couple of the bosses, as well a new system known as "Skill Tomes"

[h2][b]Skill Tomes[/b][/h2]

Firstly we have Skill Tomes. Tomes are available as drops from certain raid bosses and they're key in letting you learn new skills, expanding what your job is able to do. There are three tomes available in 1.1, one for Black Mage, one for White Mage, and one for Bard. You can read what each skill does before you get the tome, but you will need the tome to learn and equip the spell. Here is an example of what it looks like;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/ed228161da2bcca848371e675c54287bef41349b.png[/img]

Manashell is a Black Mage skill that gives the Black Mage a shield to help make them a little sturdier in raid fights. All the skill tomes are in a similar vein where they look to sure up any weaknesses that the job has, or giving the job an additional tool for their kit.

[h2][b]The Clockwork Tower[/b][/h2]

The story of the Clockwork Tower is central to the entire patch, so I won't go into it here. However, I do have screenshot previews of inside the raid, and some details on a boss. The raid itself is 6 bosses split into 2 wings, the first wing being 4 bosses and the final wing being 2. The Raid does have a Challenge mode, but instead of it being a secret phase in the final boss its a speed run, starting from 2 and ending on boss 6. This raid drops item level 90 gear, and item level 80 weapons. There is also a way to upgrade weapons from item level 80 to item level 100.  From this point on item increases will be in set increments of 50

Here is the inside of the raid; 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/aeeadeddcdf4d7eb6d9fbc12529871a86d7a489e.png[/img]

After defeating the first boss and entering the tower proper you have a choice between two bosses, but both need to be cleared before moving onto the 4th boss and the end of the raid.

The Ancient Construct is either the 2nd or 3rd encounter
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/97b04f9a2729882877539c3f9c93f07c1cb3b084.png[/img]

The Ancient Construct's encounter is themed around its massive drill. The fight is simple with the boss only having a tank buster and a raid wide, however as the fight progresses the drill begins to spin faster, as the RPM of the drill increases the attacks that the boss performs repeat. So instead of a raid wide or tank buster hitting once, they will end up hitting three or even four times. Its a fairly tight healer encounter and a fun thematic fight.

[h2][b]Release Date[/b][/h2]

Like it said in the subtitle of the post, Emperium 1.1 is being released June 15th around 11 am PDT the raid will be available on the same day, it will only be gated by story completion. With the release of this patch ALL content made prior to the release of the game will be out, I'm hoping to keep the same kind of patch cadence going forward. As always you can join the official discord [url=https://discord.gg/4ZVmSqp3sN][b]here[/b][/url] I'm usually around to answer questions or talk about the game

notes.title: Emperium Devlog #4 Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Emperium 1.1[/b][/h1]

It's been three weeks since launch, and with (hopefully) most of the bugs squashed I've gone back to working on the first major post launch update! Now I'm saying this is the first as this chunk of content was always intended as being released some time after launch. Anyway, firstly I'll announce what its called!

[i]Drum Roll[/i]

Emperium 1.1 will be titled [b]Beneath the Shadow's Tower[/b] the logo will look like this in game 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35629238/47612ecfcc1f641e062fd9a900961dc6ae5782f7.png[/img]

This update will start the trend of having new raids released on [b]odd[/b] numbered patches, ie; 1.1,1.3,1.5 this does mean Mt Invictus gear will become outdated faster than normal, but that's okay as it's a one time thing. A quick bullet point list of whats in the patch is...

[list]
[*] New 6 boss raid
[*] New 3 boss dungeon (Compatible with the Nexus)
[*] New Nexus Season (Season 1 rewards distributed, new seasonal affix "Explosive")
[*] 5 more main story chapters
[*] New "Skill Tome" system
[*] Weapon upgrade system associated with the new raid.
[*] Misc Nexus updates, including 10 new dungeon levels.
[/list]

for reference the gear from the new raid is item level 90 at base, and the weapons can be upgraded to item level 100. There will [b]not[/b] be a new tier of infusion so Mt. Invictus materials are still useful, I would recommend grinding some more out to prepare for more gear!

The new dungeon levels in the nexus serve as the hardest content the game will ever have, just speaking on the numbers. They will be a long term goal with each additional raid tier making an additional 1 or 2 levels of the nexus possible. With the new raid I believe a +15 will be the highest possible level, this is only with fully infused item level 90 gear and an item level 100 weapon.

This is it for today's blog but I plan on having previews on individual features in the coming weeks. In terms of a release date I'm simply saying soon[i]ish[/i] 

I should have more solid details on the release date in the coming weeks, the biggest factor in release is the raid and while currently it is able to be cleared from start to finish there are tuning things I need to do still that's holding me back from picking a date.

notes.title: Emperium 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Content in this patch includes;[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 	Sundered Plains Zone
[*] 	Mount Invictus Raid
[*] 	New Story Chapter
[*] 	Job Balance
[*] 	Bug Fixes
[/list]

[h2][b]The Sundered Plains[/b][/h2]

	The Sundered Plains is the first Max Level zone in the
world of Emperium. It features an extensive progression system
where the higher Reputation you have with the zone's faction the
further you can progress into the zone. Eventually unlocking the
Airship allowing you to enter the first raid "Mount Invictus"
The way you progress is by turning in Riftland Coins. Coins have a 1:1
ratio where 1 coin equals 1 reputation. You can also spend coins at a
vendor to buy seeds for your farm or gear.

The next sections will provide information on the various activities
available in the zone.

[h2][b]Heroes Call[/b][/h2]

	Three times per week you will be able to attempt a difficult
boss that requires a full party. Clearing the boss gives 150 reputation
and 100 Riftland Coins.

[h2][b]Hall of Skulls[/b][/h2]

	A unique timed dungeon with no minimum party requirement.
The rewards scale with the amount of time remaining when you finish
the gauntlet. Failing to finish in time will result in you getting the lowest
quality rewards.

[h2][b]Mt. Invictus[/b][/h2]

	Mount Invictus is an 8 boss raid instance, that drops gear ranging from item level 50 to item level 70. This will become Best in Slot until the patch 1.1 raid is released. The raid follows the weekly reset meaning you can kill these bosses 1 time every week. You are also able to extend your raid lockout by 1 in game day. 

[h2][b]Mt. Invictus Attunement[/b][/h2]

	Upon reaching 850 reputation with the zone you will unlock the raid
and the attunement quest. Within Mount Invictus Fire Resistance will be lowered significantly.
In order to counter this you can complete the attunement in order to give yourself a passive fire resistance buff. This attunement involves running dungeons, collecting materials from special gathering nodes or growing a specific crop in your farm.

	This attunement is not necessary for the first few bosses will when you reach the back half of the
raid it will become almost required.

[h2][b]Job Balance[/b][/h2]

	[h3][b]Talent Changes[/b][/h3]
Generic Physical DPS Talent "Second Chance" has been changed;
	-Chance to gain an additional action per turn has been decreased from 25% ----> 5%
[b][h3]Developer Note[/h3][/b]
	This talent was way better than anything else in the game and it was a massive oversight
to let the game be released with it in this state. Talents have a general power budget I set internally and this was going way over the allotted budget for a generic talent.
	[h3][b]Warrior[/b][/h3]
-Fell Cleave has been changed;
	-Damage formula has been changed from a.atk * 8 - b.def * 3 ----> a.atk * 5 - b.def * 3

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that tied game logic to refresh rate
[*] Fixed an issue preventing more than 1 Daily quest from being turned in at a time
[*] Fix a problem where finishing "The Nexus" chapter of the eternal quest would not allow you to teleport to The Nexus.
[*] Fixed a problem where you would be removed from a dungeon immediately upon entering has been fixed
[*] Fixed a bug where completing a Nexus Dungeon would always update your high score even if it was lower than your previous best.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you kill Ogmios in the Daybreak Caverns hard dungeon before the crystal spawns
[*] the boss will die, but you still have to kill the crystal.
[*] Fixed a bug where the burning affix was not being properly applied
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to Construct an Elemental Weapon before obtaining the proper item
[*] to start the quest line.
[/list]

[h3][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/h3]
	-You will have to unlock the Nexus again, this is because of back end changes to how the unlock is handled. This will NOT reset your seasonal stats in any way.

[h2][b]Known issues[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] A problem where encounters in Nexus Dungeons will randomly reset forcing you to fight a single boss twice making the dungeon unintentionally more difficult. The cause of this is still being looked into. If possible submitting a video of this happening would narrow down the cause a lot. 
[/list]
